architecture: Phase XIV algorithm + Phase XV native interface; no hard/soft memory control
attribution: Paired same-state local interventions and separately labelled full mutated-state closed-loop outcomes

candidate_plans.generation: Deterministic legal-edge conflicts, native per-camera capacity, GT/未来帧 forbidden

comparisons.M0: Original complete GMT/GTA (separate full frontend reference)
comparisons.M3: State/pair learned thresholds and Binary JEV
comparisons.M5: Original-rule second association and repeated Hungarian

extra_solve: Rerunning unchanged Hungarian is a no-op control, not a claimed reassociation benefit

gates.JEV_independence: All five reviewer questions require separate actual evidence; otherwise NOT_ESTABLISHED
gates.collapse: Record full native failures, retain safe baseline. Never delete a failing seed or relabel UNKNOWN
gates.engineering: Finite loss/gradients, legality, GT separation, initial native parity, order/dynamic K and full native transitions
gates.pilot: Finite learning and no label-contract violation; association improvements assessed on reused controller audit, no original MASTER safe-action gate reinterpretation
gates.science: Positive HOTA/AssA/CVIDF1 against strongest fair ordinary control plus protection/IDSW/cost evidence

metrics: Frozen TrackEval and official MATLAB; true pooled camera/scene counts, not mean-of-video HOTA
model_selection: Last fixed-budget checkpoint; use only controller audit16 for preregistered engineering/pilot gates. No DEV tuning, best-seed selection or best-checkpoint search
scope: Controlled current association learning; not future safe-action learning

split.inherited_backbone_and_initializers_expo: All24TRAIN Stage1; previous Stage2 TRAIN12/13/14/16; repeated DEV17/18/19
split.known_prior_temporal_audit: (frame//64)%5==4; preserve annotations, do not rename it independent validation
split.person_namespace: Treat GT persons within each video as dependent; audit cross-video scene/person overlap before claiming independence
split.unit: video plus GT-person dependency groups; temporal blocks are correlated diagnostics
split.video16_role: No gradients for new sprint modules; exposed to inherited initializers, not independent system heldout

supervision.cross_camera: Current GT vs certified other-camera past observations; per-view mixed/duplicate/unmatched history UNKNOWN
supervision.current_choice: Certified known past owners with current TRAIN detection GT; UNKNOWN masked
supervision.stability: Observable predecessor continuity supported by current and past certified identities; not purity alone, not future value

training.natural_sampling: Uniform video, then 64-frame block, then payload. Additional natural hard stratum has separately recorded weight; no copied rare safety events
